function: UC13 - Cancel Confirmed Booking by Shipper

history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of Cancel Confirmed Booking by Shipper function.
features: In UC13, the Shipper requests to cancel a booking that has already been confirmed. When UC13 is received, the booking request moves to CANCELLATION RECEIVED state.
•	HQ calls PKG_DCSA_HQ_CALL_AF_INTERFACE.PRC_EBK_UPDATE_USE_CASE_STATUS with the required parameters.
•	The Carrier performs an initial synchronous processing of the request to cancel the booking. The Carrier can accept or reject the request itself and responds with the appropriate HTTP status code.
•	The Carrier sets the booking cancellation status to CANCELLATION RECEIVED in the original booking.
•	DCSA event current status is updated to CANCELLATION RECEIVED [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_CURRENT_EVENT].
•	DCSA status keeps its previous status [T_LT_DCSA_DOC_HEADER.DH_DOC_STATUS].
